summary_en: Update to capital cost and stock price-conscious management framework announced May 2025. Current analysis and improvement measures and progress reviewed by board on 15 June 2026. Specific targets and metrics referenced in attached materials.
title_en: Update on Realizing Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Stock Price
translation_en_brief: On 15 June 2026, Toho Chemical Industry announced an update to its capital cost and stock price-conscious management framework, which was originally disclosed on 14 May 2025. The update reflects the board's current analysis of progress and outlines specific improvement measures and initiatives underway. The company has reassessed its framework in light of operating performance and capital allocation priorities. Full details of the revised targets, metrics, and action plan are set forth in the attached materials.
